## What's new

- **MCP servers.** Give the agent extra tools from [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io)
  servers. The new **MCP servers** dialog (plug icon in the top bar) shows each server's
  status and tools, and adds servers from presets (Filesystem, Memory, Sequential thinking,
  Context7, GitHub) or your own; **Edit mcp.json** covers everything else. MCP tool calls
  ask for your approval, except read-only tools of servers you added yourself. Servers that
  need a browser sign-in are not supported yet.
- **Starts in your home folder** when no folder was open before (instead of the folder
  CodePal happened to be launched from).

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `codepal_0.2.0_amd64.deb` | Ubuntu / Debian: `sudo apt install ./codepal_0.2.0_amd64.deb` |
| `CodePal-Setup-0.2.0.exe` | Windows installer (not code-signed: see below) |
| `CodePal-0.2.0-win.zip` | Windows, portable |

On Windows, the [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P65BRV593VW) version is
signed by Microsoft and is the one that works with Smart App Control. The installer here is
unsigned: SmartScreen asks you to confirm (*More info* > *Run anyway*), and Smart App Control
blocks it. See [Install on Windows](https://github.com/cloudforge-oy/codepal#install-on-windows).

The local MCP presets run with `npx`, so they need [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) installed.
